headline: Bitcoin dips just under $80,000 as oil stays high and Lula's win hits Brazilian markets, with the Fed, inflation data and a big options expiry all due this week.

market.asOf: BTC and ETH from a Bloomberg markets wrap (via Swissinfo) timestamped 02:59 UTC Mon 26 Oct (09:59 Bangkok). Fear & Greed reading from KuCoin's 26 Oct daily report. SOL could not be confirmed this run. Live prices are at the top of the page.
market.fearGreed: 50 (Fear & Greed Index, per KuCoin's 26 Oct report)

stories.title: Bitcoin dips just under $80,000 as oil stays high and Lula's win shakes Brazil's markets
stories.summary: Bitcoin and ether are lower as Asia opens. Oil eased a little but is still high after more missile and drone attacks on Saudi Arabia over the weekend. In Brazil, Lula won Sunday's runoff, and a Brazil fund in Tokyo fell sharply. Over the weekend, a quick drop wiped out hundreds of millions of dollars of borrowed bets on higher prices.
points: Bitcoin was down about 1.2% at about $79,437 and ether down about 2% at about $2,298, per a Bloomberg wrap on Swissinfo.
On Saturday, $436.44M of leveraged positions were forcibly closed in the four hours to 1pm ET, $404.15M of them bets on higher prices, per The Block.
Brent oil fell 2% to about $114.40 and US crude 2.1% to $101.08, per Bloomberg. Gulf News says Houthi strike claims on Saudi oil sites are not independently confirmed.
Lula won Brazil's runoff with 51.8% and all votes counted, per CBS News. A Tokyo-listed Brazil fund fell as much as 16%, per Bloomberg.

sources.label: Gulf News: Brent and WTI slip

stories.title: Fed week: rate decision Wednesday, inflation data Thursday, bitcoin options expiry Friday
stories.summary: The Fed announces its rate decision on Wednesday, and a hold is widely expected. Growth (GDP) and inflation (PCE) data land Thursday, along with Coinbase and Strategy earnings. A large batch of bitcoin options expires Friday. Spot bitcoin funds ended last week with two days of withdrawals.
points: The Fed's decision is at 2:00pm ET Wed 28 Oct (01:00 Thu Bangkok), with a press conference at 2:30pm, per the Fed's calendar.

Spot bitcoin ETFs (funds that hold bitcoin for stock-market investors) lost $635.49M on Thu 22 Oct and $137.94M on Fri 23 Oct, but still took in $304.73M over the week, per The Block citing SoSoValue.
PCE inflation is expected at 3.6% a year, up from 3.4%, per Trading Economics.
Size of Friday's options expiry: about $11.1B with "max pain" at $78,000 (CryptoQuant), or about $12.3B with max pain at $79,000 (Bitcoin News Digest).

sources.label: The Block: ETF flows and liquidations

stories.title: Security watch: Ethereum pauses a test of its next upgrade
stories.summary: Ethereum developers postponed a test run of the Glamsterdam upgrade that had been set for today, after security researchers warned that fee changes could alter how existing smart contracts behave.
points: The Glamsterdam test on the Hoodi test network had been set for 26 Oct at 17:42:48 UTC; no new date has been set, per CoinDesk.
The concern is gas (fee) accounting changes; in one case creating storage would cost 110,020 gas instead of 22,100, per CoinDesk.
A test network lets developers try an upgrade before it reaches the main Ethereum network.

briefs.title: Arthur Hayes closes his market bets
briefs.summary: The BitMEX co-founder says he closed the directional trades at his family office, Maelstrom, taking profits on ETH, ENA and UNI, citing "macro and geopolitical" risks, per The Block.

briefs.title: Retail money flows back onto exchanges
briefs.summary: 30-day retail bitcoin inflows to leading exchanges nearly doubled from $5.5B to $10.75B, a six-month high, while whale inflows fell to $3.8B, per KuCoin.

briefs.title: China court moves to confiscate about 61,900 BTC
briefs.summary: A Tianjin court accepted a request to confiscate 61,896 BTC, tied to a $5.7B fraud, starting a six-month notice period, per the Bitcoin News Digest.

briefs.title: Switzerland approves a retail spot bitcoin ETF
briefs.summary: Regulator FINMA approved BIT Asset Management's fund, with a SIX exchange listing planned for November, per the Bitcoin News Digest.

briefs.title: South Korea to track cross-border crypto transfers
briefs.summary: Draft rules scheduled to take effect on 3 Dec 2026 cover transfers to self-custody wallets, and the data could be shared with tax and financial watchdogs, per crypto.news.

briefs.title: Bitcoin mining difficulty set to rise
briefs.summary: Difficulty is projected to rise about 5% around 4pm ET Thu 29 Oct, with hashrate near 1,070 EH/s, per the Bitcoin News Digest citing mempool.space.
